# TDD Artifact — DeepSeek V4.1 Flash as the default worker model

## Non-goals

- models.workerUi stays claude-opus-5 and models.workerHeavy stays claude-fable-5-1.
- qa, prod and intake stay on Anthropic and reviewer stays on Google.
- The planner does not nominate a per-task model; modelTier.ts remains the only tier rule.
- No DeepSeek Anthropic-format endpoint and no resumable DeepSeek sessions.
- No change to worker prompts, injected skills or the worker tool set.
- No automatic fallback to Sonnet when DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is absent.

## Requirements

### REQ-001 — A run config that omits the worker models defaults models.worker and models.workerLight to deepseek-flash.

**Priority:** P0 · **Type:** functional · **PRD:** PRD section 4 goal 1 and section 5 story 1

#### SC-001-a — an empty models object defaults both regular worker tiers to DeepSeek  `unit` `green`

- **Given** a run config with no models object
- **When** RunConfig.parse is called with an empty object
- **Then** models.worker and models.workerLight are both deepseek-flash
- **Oracle:** RunConfig.parse({}).models.worker === "deepseek-flash" and RunConfig.parse({}).models.workerLight === "deepseek-flash"
- **Test doubles:** none; pure schema parse
- **Test:** `packages/shared/src/deepseek.test.ts::SC-001-a an empty models object defaults both regular worker tiers to DeepSeek`

#### SC-001-b — a default run records a DeepSeek worker session in the ledger  `acceptance` `green`

- **Given** a fixture repository with a DeepSeek key and no model overrides
- **When** a regular build task completes through charrette run
- **Then** the ledger holds a worker session on deepseek-flash priced at the DeepSeek rate
- **Oracle:** the sessions row for the task has model deepseek-flash and spentUsd equals the DeepSeek-priced sum within 0.01 USD
- **Test doubles:** fixture repository and a stubbed vendor; no live DeepSeek call
- **Test:** `apps/cli/src/cli.test.ts::SC-001-b starts a default run on the DeepSeek worker models`

### REQ-002 — A model name beginning deepseek- resolves to the deepseek provider, and an explicit deepseek/ or deepseek: prefix splits without reaching the wire id.

**Priority:** P0 · **Type:** functional · **PRD:** PRD section 7 and assumption A-001

#### SC-002-a — the deepseek family is read from the model name  `unit` `green`

- **Given** the model names deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-flash
- **When** providerFor resolves each name
- **Then** both resolve to the deepseek provider
- **Oracle:** providerFor("deepseek-flash") === "deepseek" and providerFor("deepseek-v4-flash") === "deepseek"
- **Test doubles:** none
- **Test:** `packages/shared/src/deepseek.test.ts::SC-002-a the deepseek family is read from the model name`

#### SC-002-b — an explicit deepseek prefix is split and stripped  `unit` `green`

- **Given** the model strings deepseek/deepseek-flash and deepseek:deepseek-v4-flash
- **When** splitModel and modelId run
- **Then** the provider is deepseek and the wire id is the part after the separator
- **Oracle:** splitModel("deepseek/deepseek-flash") equals {provider: "deepseek", id: "deepseek-flash"} and modelId("deepseek:deepseek-v4-flash") === "deepseek-v4-flash"
- **Test doubles:** none
- **Test:** `packages/shared/src/deepseek.test.ts::SC-002-b an explicit deepseek prefix is split and stripped`

### REQ-003 — The DeepSeek client sends OpenAI chat-completions requests to api.deepseek.com with the bearer key, sends max_tokens, echoes reasoning_content on every later tool turn, and maps a response without cached-token details to zero cache reads.

**Priority:** P0 · **Type:** functional · **PRD:** PRD section 12 and section 5 story 4

#### SC-003-a — the DeepSeek request matches the OpenAI chat-completions shape  `contract` `green`

- **Given** a recording fetch stub and a turn whose history carries a tool call
- **When** the DeepSeek client sends the turn
- **Then** the request targets api.deepseek.com with the bearer key and the OpenAI message shape
- **Oracle:** url is https://api.deepseek.com/chat/completions, headers.authorization is Bearer sk-deepseek, body.model is deepseek-flash and body.messages[0] is the system message
- **Test doubles:** fetch replaced by the recording stub
- **Test:** `packages/core/src/deepseek.test.ts::SC-003-a the DeepSeek request matches the OpenAI chat-completions shape`

#### SC-003-b — a response without cached-token details books zero cache reads  `unit` `green`

- **Given** a DeepSeek response with usage.prompt_tokens 100 and no prompt_tokens_details
- **When** the client maps the usage
- **Then** cacheReadTokens is 0 and inputTokens is 100
- **Oracle:** usage.cacheReadTokens === 0 and usage.inputTokens === 100
- **Test doubles:** fetch stub
- **Test:** `packages/core/src/deepseek.test.ts::SC-003-b a response without cached-token details books zero cache reads`

#### SC-003-c — the chain of thought comes back on the next tool turn  `unit` `green`

- **Given** a DeepSeek turn that returns reasoning_content with a tool call
- **When** the next request is sent with the same assistant message
- **Then** the request carries reasoning_content on that assistant message
- **Oracle:** the second request body has an assistant message with reasoning_content equal to the first turn's reasoning
- **Test doubles:** fetch stub
- **Test:** `packages/core/src/deepseek.test.ts::SC-003-c the chain of thought comes back on the next tool turn`

#### SC-003-d — the request sends max_tokens, the field DeepSeek documents  `unit` `green`

- **Given** a DeepSeek turn with maxOutputTokens set to 64000
- **When** the client sends the request
- **Then** the body carries max_tokens 64000 and no max_completion_tokens
- **Oracle:** body.max_tokens === 64000 and body.max_completion_tokens === undefined
- **Test doubles:** fetch stub
- **Test:** `packages/core/src/deepseek.test.ts::SC-003-d sends max_tokens, the field DeepSeek documents`

### REQ-004 — A worker routed to deepseek-flash runs through the repository tool loop, executes its tool calls and returns the final text without calling the Anthropic SDK.

**Priority:** P0 · **Type:** functional · **PRD:** PRD section 5 story 4 and section 12

#### SC-004-a — a worker session on DeepSeek drives the local tool loop  `integration` `green`

- **Given** a pool spec on deepseek-flash and a stub vendor that answers a Bash call then a final text
- **When** AgentPool.run executes the session
- **Then** the tool ran once, the result text is returned and the Anthropic SDK was never called
- **Oracle:** the tool ran once, resultText === "built it", the Anthropic query spy was not called and the request URL contains api.deepseek.com
- **Test doubles:** fetch stub and Anthropic query spy
- **Test:** `packages/core/src/poolTransport.test.ts::SC-004-a a worker session on DeepSeek drives the local tool loop`

- **Oracle:** costUsd("deepseek-flash", usage) is within 0.000001 of 0.03

- **Test:** `packages/core/src/deepseek.test.ts::SC-007-b one million cache-read tokens cost 0.03 USD`

### REQ-008 — A routing table that resolves a role to DeepSeek is refused when DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is not set, and accepted when it is.

**Priority:** P0 · **Type:** functional · **PRD:** PRD section 5 story 3 and decision DL-002

#### SC-008-a — a missing DeepSeek key is reported against the role and model  `unit` `green`

- **Given** an environment without DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
- **When** missingKeys examines models.worker set to deepseek-flash
- **Then** one sentence names DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, the worker role and the model
- **Oracle:** missingKeys({worker: "deepseek-flash"}, {}) equals ["DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is not set, but worker (deepseek-flash) is routed to deepseek."]
- **Test doubles:** none; a plain environment object
- **Test:** `packages/core/src/deepseek.test.ts::SC-008-a a missing DeepSeek key is reported against the role and model`

#### SC-008-b — a present DeepSeek key produces no violation  `unit` `green`

- **Given** an environment with DEEPSEEK_API_KEY set
- **When** missingKeys examines models.worker set to deepseek-flash
- **Then** no violation is returned
- **Oracle:** missingKeys({worker: "deepseek-flash"}, {DEEPSEEK_API_KEY: "sk-test"}) equals []
- **Test doubles:** none
- **Test:** `packages/core/src/deepseek.test.ts::SC-008-b a present DeepSeek key produces no violation`
